utterances.text: Honey, your yarn is falling off your hand. You aren't listening to the tension part. If you don't wrap it twice, the loops will just go limp. Here, let me grab your wrist— stop moving for a second.
Wait, I'm almost at the end of the row though! If I stop now, I'll lose my place in the story.
If you don't stop, you'll lose the whole blanket. Hold still. I'm re-wrapping this for you because you've let it go completely slack while you were talking about those drumsticks.
Here. Here. So I do this.
For 1 minute. I'm going to try something.
You can just do it that way, huh?
I actually knitted a blanket like this once. It's really cool.
And you turn to come back. Wrap it around your fingers. That keeps it tense. And you make one, and then you make one in the next one.
Make another one? I can't see them too well to go through there.
